title: Projection verifier compares raw event bytes to a projection row the current build re-serialized: doctor flags a native item touched across builds and graph save refuses
outcome: Projection verifier compares raw event bytes to a projection row the current build re-serialized: doctor flags a native item touched across builds and graph save refuses
acceptance: projection equality decodes both the canonical event sub-document and the projection row into the typed value and compares structurally for items, runs, root executions, claims, handoffs, blockers, and seals; a store where an event was written without a defaulted field and the projection row was refreshed by the current build verifies healthy and saves; real drift in any field is still refused; the live Engram store's doctor reports healthy on the fixed build without repair

completion.summary: Typed projection equality now allows omitted writer-materialized defaults while preserving present members and scalar encodings and rejecting duplicate known fields from original bytes. Canonical history and binding checks remain unchanged. Exact-label corruption regressions across seven families and all nine required gates pass; all required implementation children are sealed. Fable owns private-copy acceptance, landing, installation, and live verification.
